## Foundation

```{r}

library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# 1. Standardize county names in analysis data
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    county_name = str_to_upper(str_trim(County))
  )

# 2. Download Illinois county boundaries
ilco <- counties(
  state = "IL",
  cb = TRUE,
  year = 2024
)

# 3. Standardize county names in boundary data
ilco <- ilco %>%
  mutate(
    county_name = str_to_upper(str_trim(NAME))
  )

# 4. Join analysis data to county boundaries
illinois_gis <- ilco %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_data,
    by = "county_name"
  )

# 5. Check geographic join
print(illinois_gis)

# 6. Check counties without matching data
unmatched_counties <- illinois_gis %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(is.na(Population)) %>%
  select(county_name)

print(unmatched_counties)

# 7. Check number of matched and unmatched counties
cat("Total counties:", nrow(illinois_gis), "\n")
cat("Matched counties:", sum(!is.na(illinois_gis$Population)), "\n")
cat("Unmatched counties:", nrow(unmatched_counties), "\n")

geographic_boundaries <- illinois_gis %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geographic_Group)) %>%
  group_by(Geographic_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    do_union = TRUE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```

## Variables

```{r}

age_cols <- c(
  "Age 0-17 (%)",
  "Age 18-39 (%)",
  "Age 40-64 (%)",
  "Age 65 and over (%)"
)

race_cols <- c(
  "White (%)",
  "Black or African American (%)",
  "Hispanic (%)",
  "American Indian or Alaska Native (%)",
  "Asian, Native Hawaiian, or Pacific Islander (%)"
)

# Convert columns to numeric
illinois_gis <- illinois_gis %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(c(age_cols, race_cols)),
      ~ parse_number(as.character(unlist(.x)))
    )
  )
```

## Variables

```{r}

illinois_gis$Predominant_Race <- get_dominant_group(
  illinois_gis,
  race_cols,
  c("White", "Black or African American",
    "Hispanic", "American Indian or Alaska Native",
    "Asian/Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander")
)

```

## Leaflet

```{r}


# ==========================================
# ILLINOIS COUNTY HEALTH INDICATORS MAP
# ==========================================

library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------
# 1. DEFINE TOGGLEABLE VARIABLES
# ------------------------------------------

map_variables <- c(
  "White (%)",
  "Black or African American (%)",
  "Hispanic (%)",
  "American Indian or Alaska Native (%)",
  "Asian, Native Hawaiian, or Pacific Islander (%)",
  "Poverty (%)",
  "Uninsured (%)",
  "Number of Hospitals in County"
)

# Keep only columns that exist
map_variables <- intersect(
  map_variables,
  names(illinois_gis)
)

# Age variables
age_variables <- c(
  "Age 0-17 (%)",
  "Age 18-39 (%)",
  "Age 40-64 (%)",
  "Age 65 and over (%)"
)

age_variables <- intersect(
  age_variables,
  names(illinois_gis)
)

# Priority columns
iplan_cols <- paste0("Priority ", 1:3, "_IPLAN")
chna_cols  <- paste0("Priority ", 1:3, "_CHNA")

missing_iplan <- setdiff(iplan_cols, names(illinois_gis))
missing_chna  <- setdiff(chna_cols, names(illinois_gis))

print(missing_iplan)
print(missing_chna)

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. PREPARE POPULATION AND PRIORITIES
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_gis <- illinois_gis %>%
  mutate(
    Population_Label = ifelse(
      is.na(Population),
      "Not available",
      format(round(Population), big.mark = ",")
    )
  )

# Create IPLAN top-three hover labels
if (length(missing_iplan) == 0) {

  illinois_gis$IPLAN_Top_3 <- apply(
    st_drop_geometry(illinois_gis[, iplan_cols]),
    1,
    function(x) {
      paste(
        na.omit(as.character(x)),
        collapse = " | "
      )
    }
  )
}

# Create CHNA top-three hover labels
if (length(missing_chna) == 0) {

  illinois_gis$CHNA_Top_3 <- apply(
    st_drop_geometry(illinois_gis[, chna_cols]),
    1,
    function(x) {
      paste(
        na.omit(as.character(x)),
        collapse = " | "
      )
    }
  )
}

# Define available priority layers
priority_layers <- c(
  if (length(missing_iplan) == 0)
    "IPLAN Top 3 Priorities",
  if (length(missing_chna) == 0)
    "CHNA Top 3 Priorities"
)

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. GEOGRAPHIC GROUP COLORS
# ------------------------------------------

group_palette <- c(
  "#527D9A",
  "#A66B58",
  "#78916A",
  "#927DA8",
  "#B18C4E",
  "#568F8B"
)

group_colors <- colorFactor(
  palette = group_palette,
  domain = geographic_boundaries$Geographic_Group
)

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. START LEAFLET MAP
# ------------------------------------------

bbox <- st_bbox(illinois_gis)

illinois_map <- leaflet(
  options = leafletOptions(
    zoomControl = TRUE,
    minZoom = 5,
    maxZoom = 10
  )
) %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap.Mapnik") %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = as.numeric(bbox["xmin"]),
    lat1 = as.numeric(bbox["ymin"]),
    lng2 = as.numeric(bbox["xmax"]),
    lat2 = as.numeric(bbox["ymax"])
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 5. ADD DEMOGRAPHIC AND HEALTHCARE LAYERS
# ------------------------------------------

for (variable in map_variables) {

  values <- illinois_gis[[variable]]

  if (is.numeric(values)) {

    palette <- colorNumeric(
      palette = "Blues",
      domain = values,
      na.color = "transparent"
    )

    colors <- palette(values)

    labels <- ifelse(
      is.na(values),
      "Not available",
      if (variable == "Number of Hospitals in County") {
        paste0(variable, ": ", round(values, 0))
      } else {
        paste0(variable, ": ", round(values, 2), "%")
      }
    )

  } else {

    palette <- colorFactor(
      palette = "Set2",
      domain = values,
      na.color = "transparent"
    )

    colors <- palette(values)

    labels <- paste0(
      variable, ": ",
      ifelse(
        is.na(values),
        "Not available",
        as.character(values)
      )
    )
  }

  illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = illinois_gis,
      fillColor = colors,
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#777777",
      weight = 0.5,
      opacity = 0.8,
      group = variable,
      label = paste0(
        illinois_gis$County,
        " | Population: ",
        illinois_gis$Population_Label,
        " | ",
        labels
      ),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 2,
        color = "#222222",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------
# 6. ADD AGE GROUP LAYERS
# LIGHTER YOUNGER / DARKER OLDER
# ------------------------------------------

age_palettes <- list(
  "Age 0-17 (%)" = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7"),
  "Age 18-39 (%)" = c("#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1"),
  "Age 40-64 (%)" = c("#9ECAE1", "#4292C6"),
  "Age 65 and over (%)" = c("#4292C6", "#084594")
)

for (variable in age_variables) {

  values <- illinois_gis[[variable]]

  age_palette <- colorNumeric(
    palette = age_palettes[[variable]],
    domain = values,
    na.color = "transparent"
  )

  age_labels <- paste0(
    illinois_gis$County,
    " | Population: ",
    illinois_gis$Population_Label,
    " | ",
    variable,
    ": ",
    ifelse(
      is.na(values),
      "Not available",
      paste0(round(values, 1), "%")
    )
  )

  illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = illinois_gis,
      fillColor = age_palette(values),
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      color = "#777777",
      weight = 0.5,
      group = variable,
      label = age_labels,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 2,
        color = "#222222",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------
# 7. ADD IPLAN TOP 3 PRIORITIES
# ------------------------------------------

if (length(missing_iplan) == 0) {

  iplan_palette <- colorFactor(
    palette = "Set3",
    domain = illinois_gis[[iplan_cols[1]]],
    na.color = "transparent"
  )

  illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = illinois_gis,
      fillColor = iplan_palette(
        illinois_gis[[iplan_cols[1]]]
      ),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#777777",
      weight = 0.5,
      group = "IPLAN Top 3 Priorities",
      label = paste0(
        illinois_gis$County,
        " | Population: ",
        illinois_gis$Population_Label,
        " | Top 3 IPLAN Priorities: ",
        illinois_gis$IPLAN_Top_3
      )
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------
# 8. ADD CHNA TOP 3 PRIORITIES
# ------------------------------------------

if (length(missing_chna) == 0) {

  chna_palette <- colorFactor(
    palette = "Set3",
    domain = illinois_gis[[chna_cols[1]]],
    na.color = "transparent"
  )

  illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = illinois_gis,
      fillColor = chna_palette(
        illinois_gis[[chna_cols[1]]]
      ),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#777777",
      weight = 0.5,
      group = "CHNA Top 3 Priorities",
      label = paste0(
        illinois_gis$County,
        " | Population: ",
        illinois_gis$Population_Label,
        " | Top 3 CHNA Priorities: ",
        illinois_gis$CHNA_Top_3
      )
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------
# 9. PERMANENT COUNTY BOUNDARIES
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = illinois_gis,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = "#555555",
    weight = 0.7,
    opacity = 0.9
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 10. PERMANENT GEOGRAPHIC GROUP BOUNDARIES
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = geographic_boundaries,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = ~group_colors(Geographic_Group),
    weight = 2.5,
    opacity = 0.95,
    label = ~as.character(Geographic_Group)
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 11. GEOGRAPHIC GROUP LEGEND
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    pal = group_colors,
    values = geographic_boundaries$Geographic_Group,
    title = "Geographic Groups",
    opacity = 1
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 12. MAP SCALE
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
  addScaleBar(
    position = "bottomleft",
    options = scaleBarOptions(
      metric = TRUE,
      imperial = FALSE,
      maxWidth = 150
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 13. MAP TITLE
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
  addControl(
    html = HTML("
      <div style='
        background: white;
        padding: 12px 18px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        max-width: 330px;
      '>
        <h4 style='
          margin: 0 0 5px 0;
          color: #17324D;
          font-weight: 600;
        '>
          Illinois County Health Indicators
        </h4>
        <div style='
          font-size: 12px;
          color: #555;
        '>
          Demographics, healthcare access, and
          community health priorities
        </div>
      </div>
    "),
    position = "topleft"
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 14. LAYER CONTROLS
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map <- illinois_map %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(
      map_variables,
      age_variables,
      priority_layers
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(
      collapsed = TRUE,
      position = "bottomright"
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 15. DISPLAY MAP
# ------------------------------------------

illinois_map


```

## Save

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------
# 16. SAVE INTERACTIVE MAP AS HTML
# ------------------------------------------

library(htmlwidgets)

# Create output folder
dir.create(
  "/Users/kmcdaniel/Desktop/apex/graph",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Export Leaflet map
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  widget = illinois_map,
  file = "/Users/kmcdaniel/Desktop/apex/graph/Illinois_County_Health_Indicators.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

```
